data.body: [P2] Re-evaluate termination before continuing the current callback round. Setting this flag does not stop the `for` loop, and the status gate below is skipped when no successful heartbeat follow-up remains. If an early-exit/racing callback appears before a peer in history order, its success or failure can finish execution and the subsequent peer send records a spurious `CallbackError`. Stop or reconcile remaining sends after each successful terminal action, and add reversed-order and RUNNING-then-terminal regression cases.
